title: GenomicLinks: Deep learning predictions of 3D chromatin loops in the maize genome
authors: Schlegel L; Bhardwaj R; Shahryary Y; Demirtürk D; Marand AP; Schmitz RJ; Johannes F
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习模型GenomicLinks预测玉米基因组3D染色质环，并发现转录因子bHLH结合基序驱动远端互作，虽非直接TF-DNA结合建模，但聚焦TF基序与染色质互作，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Gene regulation in eukaryotes is partly shaped by the 3D organization of chro]matin within the cell nucleus. Distal interactions between cis -regulatory elements and their target genes are widespread and many causal loci underlying heritable agricultural traits have been mapped to distal non-coding elements. The biology underlying chromatin loop formation in plants is poorly understood. Dissecting the sequence features that mediate distal interactions is an important step toward identifying putative molecular mechanisms. Here, we trained GenomicLinks, a deep learning model, to identify DNA sequence features predictive of 3D chromatin interactions in maize. We found that the presence of binding motifs of specific Transcription Factor classes, especially bHLH, are predictive of chromatin interaction specificities. Using an in silico mutagenesis approach we show the removal of these motifs from loop anchors leads to reduced interaction probabilities. We were able to validate these predictions with single-cell co-accessibility data from different maize genotypes that harbor natural substitutions in these TF binding motifs. GenomicLinks is currently implemented as an open-source web tool, which should facilitate its wider use in the plant research community.
abstract_zh: 真核生物中的基因调控部分受到细胞核内染色质三维组织的影响。顺式调控元件与其靶基因之间的远端相互作用普遍存在，许多决定可遗传农业性状的因果位点已被定位到远端非编码元件上。植物中染色质环形成的生物学机制尚不明确。解析介导远端相互作用的序列特征，是识别潜在分子机制的重要一步。在此，我们训练了GenomicLinks，一种深度学习模型，以识别预测玉米三维染色质相互作用的DNA序列特征。我们发现，特定转录因子类别（尤其是bHLH）的结合基序的存在，可预测染色质相互作用的特异性。通过计算机模拟诱变方法，我们展示了从环锚点移除这些基序会导致相互作用概率降低。我们能够利用来自不同玉米基因型的单细胞共可及性数据验证这些预测，这些基因型在这些转录因子结合基序中携带自然替换。GenomicLinks目前作为开源网络工具实现，应有助于其在植物研究社区中的更广泛应用。
